company.name: Bold Metrics
company.shortDescription: Bold Metrics is a SaaS solution for retailers that reduces product returns and inform better design practices.
company.description:
Bold Metrics is building a sustainable future by reducing product returns and informing better design practices. The leading fit technology company headquartered in San Francisco, Bold Metrics uses A. I and machine learning technologies to empower apparel brands to reduce returns, boost conversions, and improve sustainability. Their SaaS solutions provide a simple, scalable way for brands to predict customer body measurements accurately while connecting customers to better-fitting clothing and generating powerful, actionable insights to supercharge the supply chain and reduce a brand's environmental footprint.

Used by trusted brands to reduce fit-related returns, from size recommendations that take into consideration a customer's body shape and fit preference, to enterprise-level solutions that optimize manufacturing from design to distribution, our technology improves the customer experience both in-store and online.

aiResearchSummary.text: Artificial intelligence systems for generation of human body part measurements and human body fit information describe generating body measurements from user data to build body realistic avatars and infer fit characteristics. Methods and systems for user environment customization based on non fungible body data extend these measurements to personalized digital environments. Together, these efforts show research into AI driven body measurement, fit prediction, and user specific virtual experiences.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $8,000,000, or 62.73% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,180,260 to $56,108,543, a 25.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
